scope: Owner-requested standalone demo showing how the approved Sky Lagoon v5 painted flat can feel alive and touchable without redrawing it: shader breeze, water shimmer, cloud drift, depth warp and tap ripples on the unchanged plate, plus chimney smoke, meadow motes, butterflies, animal startles, Roshan travel and twirl. It is deliberately not integrated into the main game (no change to main.tscn, main.gd or the shipping promenade). Also a written Codex handoff naming the art gaps the painting cannot supply. Benefit: gives the owner a concrete, A/B-switchable way to judge 'alive painting' techniques before any art or integration spend.
no_findings_reason: Standalone evaluation scene that is not reachable from the shipping game, so no finding's runtime state changes. Related MA-VIS-002 (Sky Lagoon visual medium) and MA-ROSHAN-006 (still Roshan sliding along the Sky Lagoon) keep their lifecycles; the demo's swim-atlas travel only informs a later repair.

validation.evidence: Official 4.7.2-stable linux zip, SHA-512 verified against .github/workflows/probes.yml GODOT_ZIP_SHA512; no analyzer errors or warnings.

validation.command: python3 -m gdtoolkit.parser (gdtoolkit==4.5.0) and python3 tools/lint_inference.py on both new scripts

validation.evidence: SKY_ALIVE PASS failures=0. Covers material classification at 8 points, water/foliage/cloud/sky/cabin/animal/Roshan/ground taps, startle atlas use, twirl, route travel 1872->3596, and no save-file write. Motion measurement skipped headless.

The container has no Vulkan (VK_KHR_surface missing), so Godot fell back to gl_compatibility on llvmpipe. That is not Mobile-renderer evidence. In-memory frame differences, no files written, mean 0-255: water 6.27 on / 0.00 off, foliage 18.01 / 0.28, sky clouds 1.18 / 0.00, bare path 0.07 / 0.00. Reported fps on software rendering is about 31 after the one-time GPU mask pass (it was about 9 when classifying every frame); not phone timing.
ROSHAN2D ALL OK; PROBE_PARITY ALL OK. The new probe is not added to the trusted CI roster because the demo is not integrated.
